Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were
involved in at the location in League City, Texas. Pelase state your full name for the record.
A: Sure. I'd rather not give my full name on the recording, so I'll just say I'm the driver of the vehicle that was struck
head-on.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe what happened as best you can remember?
A: I was heading down the road in my own lane, going slowly because of the traffic ahead. The other car drifted over
the center line and we ended up nose to nose. It wasn't a hard hit, but the airbags didn't deploy and both cars were
still drivable for a moment.
Q: How fast do you believe you were traveling?
A: Maybe fifteen or twenty miles an hour. I was slowing down, so I doubt it was more than that.
Q: Did you receive medical attention after the collision?
A: Yes. An ambulance took me to the hospital. They X-rayed my arm and wrist and told me I had a fracture in my
wrist. I'm wearing a splint now and I've got a follow-up appointment with a specialist.
Q: Are you still experiencing pain or limited movement?
A: Yes, especially when I grip anything or try to turn a doorknob. The doctor said it will take several weeks to heal
properly, and I may need physical therapy.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'll send you the medical records once I get them.
Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
</page>

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
